t: US Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA)
s: When a PMN is approved, a 'Notice of Commencement' (NOC) is required to be submitted to EPA within 30 days of first importation or production. Following receipt of this NOC, the subject chemical substance will be added to EPA's TSCA Inventory of existing chemical substances for the purposes of future importation and/or domestic production.
